sentences.en: Ming was a quiet boy who lived in a small town in the south.
sentences.zh: 明是一个安静的男孩，住在南方的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: His father worked far away in another place for most of the year.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在很远的另一个地方工作，一年中大部分时间都不在家。

sentences.en: One winter morning, Ming got up very early.
sentences.zh: 一个冬天的早晨，明起得很早。

sentences.en: He wanted to travel to the city to see everyone.
sentences.zh: 他想动身去城里看望大家。

sentences.en: It was a cold day, so he wore his warmest coat.
sentences.zh: 那是一个寒冷的日子，所以他穿上了最暖和的外套。

sentences.en: His grandmother stood at the station to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 他的奶奶站在车站为他送行。

sentences.en: The old station was quiet in the pale morning light.
sentences.zh: 清晨微弱的光线里，老车站十分安静。

sentences.en: She gave him a small box before the train left.
sentences.zh: 火车开动之前，她递给他一个小盒子。

sentences.en: Inside there was a beautiful card for the new sister.
sentences.zh: 里面有一张漂亮的卡片，是送给新出生的妹妹的。

sentences.en: There was also a soft blue toy inside it.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一个柔软的蓝色玩具。

sentences.en: Grandmother said, 'Please bring this to the baby.'
sentences.zh: 奶奶说：“请把这个带给小宝宝。”

sentences.en: 'Your brother will love this book,' she added.
sentences.zh: “你哥哥会喜欢这本书的，”她补充道。

sentences.en: Ming held the box close to his chest and promised to keep it safe.
sentences.zh: 明把盒子紧紧抱在胸前，保证会好好保管它。

sentences.en: Then the train doors shut, and the journey started.
sentences.zh: 然后车门关上了，旅程开始了。

sentences.en: The train moved fast through fields and hills.
sentences.zh: 火车飞快地穿过田野和山丘。

sentences.en: Ming looked out of the window and thought about his new school.
sentences.zh: 明望着窗外，想着他的新学校。

sentences.en: He would soon join the English class there.
sentences.zh: 他很快就要在那里加入英语班了。

sentences.en: After three hours, the train finally stopped.
sentences.zh: 三个小时后，火车终于停了下来。

sentences.en: His father waited near a black car outside the station.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在车站外一辆黑色汽车旁等着。

sentences.en: Ming ran to him with a big smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 明满脸笑容地朝他跑去。

sentences.en: The station was noisy, full of people and rolling bags.
sentences.zh: 车站很吵，到处都是人和滚动的行李箱。

sentences.en: They drove between tall buildings and bright lights that never seemed to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他们的车行驶在高楼和似乎永不熄灭的灯光之间。

sentences.en: Everything here looked new and exciting to Ming.
sentences.zh: 这里的一切在明看来都新鲜又令人兴奋。

sentences.en: At home, his older brother Jun opened the door for them.
sentences.zh: 到家时，哥哥小军为他们打开了门。

sentences.en: But when Ming opened his bag, his heart stopped.
sentences.zh: 可是当明打开背包时，他的心一下子沉了下去。

sentences.en: The small box from grandmother was not there.
sentences.zh: 奶奶给的那个小盒子不见了。

sentences.en: 'This is so bad,' he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “这太糟糕了，”他小声说。

sentences.en: Tears filled his eyes, and he looked down at the floor.
sentences.zh: 泪水涌进他的眼睛，他低头看着地板。

sentences.en: His joy disappeared in a single moment.
sentences.zh: 他的喜悦在一瞬间消失了。

sentences.en: His father said, 'Do not worry, we can look for it.'
sentences.zh: 父亲说：“别担心，我们可以去找它。”

sentences.en: 'Where did you go today?' Jun asked him.
sentences.zh: “你今天都去哪儿了？”小军问他。

sentences.en: Ming tried to remember, but his answer was not clear.
sentences.zh: 明努力回忆，但他的回答并不清楚。

sentences.en: 'I walked past a library near the station,' he said.
sentences.zh: “我路过了车站附近的一家图书馆，”他说。

sentences.en: 'Maybe I put it on a table somewhere and forgot it.'
sentences.zh: “也许我把它放在哪张桌子上忘了拿。”

sentences.en: Father promised they would drive back the next morning.
sentences.zh: 父亲答应第二天早上开车回去找。

sentences.en: That night, Ming lay in his bed and could not sleep at all.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，明躺在床上，怎么也睡不着。

sentences.en: He kept thinking about grandmother's kind, wrinkled hands.
sentences.zh: 他一直想着奶奶那双慈祥而布满皱纹的手。

sentences.en: The next morning, they returned to the old library near the station.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们回到了车站附近那家旧图书馆。

sentences.en: A girl with long dark hair stood near the steps.
sentences.zh: 一个留着深色长发的女孩站在台阶旁。

sentences.en: A brown dog sat quietly beside her.
sentences.zh: 一只棕色的小狗安静地坐在她身旁。

sentences.en: The dog looked up with kind, gentle eyes.
sentences.zh: 小狗抬起头，眼神温柔友善。

sentences.en: 'Are you looking for something?' the girl said warmly.
sentences.zh: “你们在找什么东西吗？”女孩热情地问。

sentences.en: 'I lost a small box somewhere yesterday,' Ming told her sadly.
sentences.zh: “我昨天在附近丢了一个小盒子，”明难过地告诉她。

sentences.en: 'I am glad to help you look,' she said.
sentences.zh: “我很乐意帮你一起找，”她说。

sentences.en: 'My name is Hua, and this is my dog, Doudou.'
sentences.zh: “我叫小华，这是我的狗豆豆。”

sentences.en: They searched behind every shelf in the reading room.
sentences.zh: 他们在阅览室里每个书架后面都找了一遍。

sentences.en: Hua looked inside a large cupboard near the front desk.
sentences.zh: 小华查看了前台旁边的一个大柜子。

sentences.en: Ming checked under the tables and by the window.
sentences.zh: 明检查了桌子底下和窗户旁边。

sentences.en: But the box was not in the building at all.
sentences.zh: 可是整栋楼里根本没有那个盒子。

sentences.en: 'Think again,' said Hua, 'where else did you stop?'
sentences.zh: “再想想，”小华说，“你还在哪里停留过？”

sentences.en: Ming closed his eyes and tried very hard to remember every step.
sentences.zh: 明闭上眼睛，努力回忆每一步。

sentences.en: 'There was a park with green grass,' he said slowly.
sentences.zh: “有一个长着绿草的公园，”他慢慢地说。

sentences.en: 'Some boys played football there, and I watched the game.'
sentences.zh: “有几个男孩在那儿踢足球，我看了一会儿比赛。”

sentences.en: They hurried to the park together, with Doudou running happily ahead.
sentences.zh: 他们一起赶往公园，豆豆开心地跑在前面。

sentences.en: A group of children were kicking a ball on the field.
sentences.zh: 一群孩子正在场地上踢球。

sentences.en: Hua walked over and questioned them in a friendly voice.
sentences.zh: 小华走过去，友好地询问他们。

sentences.en: One child pointed at a bench under a tree.
sentences.zh: 一个孩子指向树下的一条长椅。

sentences.en: 'A man found a box there,' he told them.
sentences.zh: “有个男人在那儿捡到了一个盒子，”他告诉他们。

sentences.en: 'He carried it to the art center across the street.'
sentences.zh: “他把盒子送到了街对面的艺术中心。”

sentences.en: Ming began to feel hope run through his whole body.
sentences.zh: 明感到希望涌遍了全身。

sentences.en: 'Come on, let us hurry!' Hua called to him.
sentences.zh: “快来，我们赶紧走！”小华朝他喊道。

sentences.en: The art center was a bright building with red walls and wide windows.
sentences.zh: 艺术中心是一座明亮的建筑，有红色的墙和宽大的窗户。

sentences.en: Inside, a Chinese painting lesson had just finished.
sentences.zh: 里面的一节中国画课刚刚结束。

sentences.en: Pictures of China hung on the walls around them.
sentences.zh: 他们周围的墙上挂着关于中国的画。

sentences.en: An old teacher walked toward them with slow steps.
sentences.zh: 一位年长的老师迈着缓慢的步子朝他们走来。

sentences.en: 'Excuse me, did anyone leave a small lost box with you today?' Ming said.
sentences.zh: “打扰一下，今天有人把捡到的小盒子送来吗？”明说。

sentences.en: The teacher smiled and raised his hand.
sentences.zh: 老师微笑着举起了手。

sentences.en: 'Yes, a kind man left it here half an hour ago.'
sentences.zh: “有的，半小时前一位好心人把它留在了这里。”

sentences.en: He turned his head and pointed to a shelf.
sentences.zh: 他转过头，指向一个架子。

sentences.en: There it was on the shelf, the small box from grandmother!
sentences.zh: 它就在架子上——奶奶给的那个小盒子！

sentences.en: Ming could hear his own heart beating with joy.
sentences.zh: 明能听见自己的心因喜悦而怦怦直跳。

sentences.en: He opened it slowly and checked everything inside with careful fingers.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢打开盒子，用手指仔细检查里面的每样东西。

sentences.en: The card and the toy were both fine.
sentences.zh: 卡片和玩具都完好无损。

sentences.en: 'Thank you so much, you are a true friend,' he said to Hua.
sentences.zh: “太感谢你了，你是真正的朋友，”他对小华说。

sentences.en: 'That is good news for everyone,' Hua said with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “这对大家来说都是好消息，”小华笑着说。

sentences.en: 'Come and see Doudou and me any time,' she added.
sentences.zh: “随时都可以来看我和豆豆，”她又说。

sentences.en: Doudou barked twice and wagged his short tail.
sentences.zh: 豆豆叫了两声，摇着短短的尾巴。

sentences.en: That evening, the whole family sat together for dinner.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，全家人坐在一起吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Father cooked warm food, and everyone started to eat.
sentences.zh: 父亲做了热腾腾的饭菜，大家开始吃起来。

sentences.en: Ming gave the card to his little sister first.
sentences.zh: 明先把卡片送给了小妹妹。

sentences.en: She touched it with her tiny fingers and laughed out loud.
sentences.zh: 她用小小的手指摸着卡片，大声笑了起来。

sentences.en: Then Jun opened his new book with shining eyes.
sentences.zh: 接着小军睁着发亮的眼睛翻开了他的新书。

sentences.en: 'Grandmother always knows what we like,' Jun said.
sentences.zh: “奶奶总是知道我们喜欢什么，”小军说。

sentences.en: Ming told them the whole story of Hua and her clever dog.
sentences.zh: 明给他们讲了小华和她聪明的小狗的整个故事。

sentences.en: 'Grandmother will be so happy about this,' Father said.
sentences.zh: “奶奶知道这件事一定会很高兴，”父亲说。

sentences.en: A week later, Ming had his first lesson at the new school.
sentences.zh: 一个星期后，明在新学校上了第一节课。

sentences.en: To his surprise, Hua was sitting in the same room, smiling at him.
sentences.zh: 让他惊喜的是，小华就坐在同一间教室里，正朝他微笑。

sentences.en: 'Learning here is not difficult with a friend,' she told him.
sentences.zh: “有朋友在，这里的学习就不难，”她告诉他。

sentences.en: 'The homework will feel easy if we work together.'
sentences.zh: “我们一起做作业就会觉得很容易。”

sentences.en: Ming worked hard in class because he wanted to get better every week.
sentences.zh: 明在课堂上很用功，因为他想每个星期都进步一点。

sentences.en: One cool evening, they all watched a funny film.
sentences.zh: 一个凉爽的晚上，他们一起看了一部有趣的电影。

sentences.en: Later that evening, Father took everyone out to buy sweet ice cream.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，父亲带大家出去买了香甜的冰淇淋。

sentences.en: 'This has been a great winter,' Ming thought with a smile.
sentences.zh: “这真是一个很棒的冬天，”明微笑着想。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone — I want to tell you a story about last year.
sentences.zh: 大家好——我想给你们讲一个关于去年的故事。

sentences.en: My name is Leo, and I am twelve years old.
sentences.zh: 我叫利奥，今年十二岁。

sentences.en: I live with my mother in a small town.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈住在一个小镇上。

sentences.en: Our house is at the end of a quiet road.
sentences.zh: 我们的房子在一条安静的路的尽头。

sentences.en: A small river runs near the town, and children swim there.
sentences.zh: 一条小河从镇子附近流过，孩子们常在那里游泳。

sentences.en: In summer, the water looks bright and cool under the sun.
sentences.zh: 夏天，河水在阳光下显得明亮又清凉。

sentences.en: That season, everything changed for me.
sentences.zh: 那个季节，我的一切都改变了。

sentences.en: One hot morning, I found my mom in bed, very tired.
sentences.zh: 一个炎热的早晨，我发现妈妈躺在床上，非常疲惫。

sentences.en: She could not stand up, and her face was pale.
sentences.zh: 她站不起来，脸色苍白。

sentences.en: I did not know what to do at first.
sentences.zh: 一开始我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Then I called for help, and soon a car came to take her away.
sentences.zh: 然后我打电话求助，很快一辆车来把她接走了。

sentences.en: They took my mom to the hospital in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们把我妈妈送到了城里的医院。

sentences.en: The doctors said she needed to stay there for a month.
sentences.zh: 医生说她需要在那里住一个月。

sentences.en: I felt small and afraid, but I tried to be strong.
sentences.zh: 我感到渺小又害怕，但我努力让自己坚强。

sentences.en: The house was quiet, and I ate dinner alone that first evening.
sentences.zh: 房子里静悄悄的，第一天晚上我一个人吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: My aunt came to stay with me at our home.
sentences.zh: 我的姑姑来到我们家陪我住。

sentences.en: She was kind, but the rooms still felt empty.
sentences.zh: 她很和善，但房间里仍然显得空荡荡的。

sentences.en: School was closed, so the days felt very long.
sentences.zh: 学校放假了，所以日子显得特别漫长。

sentences.en: I could not sleep well at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上我睡不好觉。

sentences.en: I would miss her warm voice and her funny jokes.
sentences.zh: 我很想念妈妈温暖的声音和有趣的笑话。

sentences.en: Sometimes I walked by the water for an hour alone.
sentences.zh: 有时我会独自在河边走上一个小时。

sentences.en: I often went to the park just to sit and think.
sentences.zh: 我常常去公园，只是坐着想事情。

sentences.en: Even my favorite games did not feel fun without her.
sentences.zh: 没有她，连我最喜欢的游戏也变得没意思了。

sentences.en: One morning, I heard music coming from the trees.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，我听到树林那边传来音乐声。

sentences.en: An old man sat on a bench with a guitar.
sentences.zh: 一位老人抱着吉他坐在长椅上。

sentences.en: His hair was white, and his eyes were bright.
sentences.zh: 他的头发是白色的，眼睛却很明亮。

sentences.en: He played a song that sounded happy and sad at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他弹的那首歌听起来既快乐又忧伤。

sentences.en: I stopped to listen for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我停下来听了很久。

sentences.en: The sound floated over the grass and the trees.
sentences.zh: 琴声飘过草地和树林。

sentences.en: He looked up and asked, 'Do you like music, young friend?'
sentences.zh: 他抬起头问：“小朋友，你喜欢音乐吗？”

sentences.en: 'Yes,' I said, 'very much.'
sentences.zh: “喜欢，”我说，“非常喜欢。”

sentences.en: 'My name is Mr. Bell,' he told me with a warm smile.
sentences.zh: “我叫贝尔先生，”他带着温暖的笑容告诉我。

sentences.en: Mr. Bell asked me to meet him the next day.
sentences.zh: 贝尔先生让我第二天再来见他。

sentences.en: It was a nice idea, and I agreed at once.
sentences.zh: 这是个好主意，我立刻答应了。

sentences.en: He began to teach me how to hold and play the guitar.
sentences.zh: 他开始教我怎样握吉他、弹吉他。

sentences.en: It was hard at first, but also very interesting.
sentences.zh: 一开始很难，但也非常有趣。

sentences.en: He said music can be a light in a dark room.
sentences.zh: 他说音乐可以成为黑暗房间里的一盏灯。

sentences.en: 'Open your ears and your heart,' he told me.
sentences.zh: “打开你的耳朵和心，”他对我说。

sentences.en: I went to see him every day after that.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我每天都去看他。

sentences.en: Little by little, my fingers grew faster and surer.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，我的手指变得又快又稳。

sentences.en: He also told me stories about his life as a young player.
sentences.zh: 他还给我讲他年轻时当乐手的故事。

sentences.en: One day, I had a new plan.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我有了一个新计划。

sentences.en: I wanted to learn a special piece for my mom.
sentences.zh: 我想为妈妈学一首特别的曲子。

sentences.en: It was the song she sang to me when I was a baby.
sentences.zh: 那是我小时候她唱给我听的歌。

sentences.en: Mr. Bell wrote the notes on paper and put it on the table.
sentences.zh: 贝尔先生把乐谱写在纸上，放在桌上。

sentences.en: 'Take this home and study it every day,' he said.
sentences.zh: “把它带回家，每天练习，”他说。

sentences.en: My aunt let me practice in my room each evening.
sentences.zh: 姑姑让我每天晚上在房间里练习。

sentences.en: Every evening after dinner, I played the same notes again and again.
sentences.zh: 每天晚饭后，我一遍又一遍地弹同样的音符。

sentences.en: Now I had something important to do.
sentences.zh: 现在我有一件重要的事情要做了。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, on my way to a lesson, something bad happened.
sentences.zh: 两个星期后，在去上课的路上，发生了一件糟糕的事。

sentences.en: I left the music paper on a bus.
sentences.zh: 我把乐谱落在了公交车上。

sentences.en: I ran after the bus, but it was too fast.
sentences.zh: 我追着公交车跑，但它开得太快了。

sentences.en: I stood in the middle of the street and wanted to cry.
sentences.zh: 我站在街中央，想要哭出来。

sentences.en: My heart beat fast, and my hands felt cold.
sentences.zh: 我的心跳得很快，双手冰凉。

sentences.en: A police officer saw me and asked what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 一位警察看见了我，问我出了什么事。

sentences.en: I told her about the paper and the song for my mother.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她乐谱的事，还有那首为妈妈准备的歌。

sentences.en: 'Please help me find it,' I said.
sentences.zh: “请帮我找到它，”我说。

sentences.en: She made some calls, and men at the bus station began to search.
sentences.zh: 她打了几个电话，车站的工作人员开始寻找。

sentences.en: We waited together, and she told me not to worry.
sentences.zh: 我们一起等着，她让我别担心。

sentences.en: Soon, a driver found the paper under a seat.
sentences.zh: 不久，一位司机在座位下找到了那张纸。

sentences.en: It was late in the afternoon when I got it back.
sentences.zh: 我拿回它时，已经是傍晚了。

sentences.en: 'No more buses for this paper,' I joked, and the officer laughed.
sentences.zh: “这张纸再也不坐公交车了，”我开玩笑说，警察也笑了。

sentences.en: I thanked her many times before I walked back.
sentences.zh: 回去之前，我谢了她很多次。

sentences.en: I held the paper close to my chest all the way.
sentences.zh: 一路上我把纸紧紧抱在胸前。

sentences.en: That night, I read the notes again and again.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我把乐谱读了一遍又一遍。

sentences.en: The marks on the page were like stars showing me the way.
sentences.zh: 纸上的音符就像指引我方向的星星。

sentences.en: Before bed, I put it in a safe box beside my pillow.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前，我把它放进枕边一个安全的盒子里。

sentences.en: At the end of the month, the doctors had good news too.
sentences.zh: 月底的时候，医生们也带来了好消息。

sentences.en: My mom was much better and could come back soon.
sentences.zh: 妈妈好多了，很快就能回来。

sentences.en: The nurses planned a small party in her room.
sentences.zh: 护士们计划在她的病房里办一个小型聚会。

sentences.en: Mr. Bell came with me to the hospital and carried his old guitar.
sentences.zh: 贝尔先生和我一起去医院，还带着他的旧吉他。

sentences.en: Many people from the hospital came to hear us.
sentences.zh: 医院里的很多人都来听我们演奏。

sentences.en: Some were doctors in white, and one nurse wore a red flower.
sentences.zh: 有些是穿白大褂的医生，还有一位护士戴着一朵红花。

sentences.en: I took a deep breath and began to speak.
sentences.zh: 我深吸一口气，开始讲话。

sentences.en: 'Mom, this song is for you,' I said.
sentences.zh: “妈妈，这首歌是送给你的，”我说。

sentences.en: Mr. Bell smiled and gave me a small nod.
sentences.zh: 贝尔先生微笑着朝我轻轻点了点头。

sentences.en: My hands were not shaking anymore.
sentences.zh: 我的手不再发抖了。

sentences.en: I played the song from the first note to the last.
sentences.zh: 我把这首歌从第一个音弹到了最后一个音。

sentences.en: It was short, but it came from my heart.
sentences.zh: 它很短，但发自我的内心。

sentences.en: The room was quiet when the last note ended.
sentences.zh: 最后一个音符结束时，房间里一片安静。

sentences.en: My mom cried and held my hand for a long time.
sentences.zh: 妈妈哭了，握着我的手很久很久。

sentences.en: Her eyes were bright with happy tears.
sentences.zh: 她的眼里闪着幸福的泪光。

sentences.en: 'I am sorry I could not visit you more,' I said softly.
sentences.zh: “对不起，我没能常来看你，”我轻声说。

sentences.en: 'You were here in the right place today,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “今天你来到了最该来的地方，”她回答。

sentences.en: 'You make people happy with this,' Mr. Bell told me, and someone took a picture of us.
sentences.zh: “你的音乐让大家快乐，”贝尔先生对我说，这时有人给我们拍了一张照片。

sentences.en: Mom came back the next week.
sentences.zh: 第二个星期，妈妈回家了。

sentences.en: The house felt warm again, and its rooms were full of laughter.
sentences.zh: 家里又变得温暖，每个房间都充满了笑声。

sentences.en: High above the town, the summer sun was shining.
sentences.zh: 夏日的太阳高高地照耀着小镇。

sentences.en: We often talk about that strange, special time.
sentences.zh: 我们常常谈起那段奇特而特别的时光。

sentences.en: Mr. Bell still teaches me by the water every week.
sentences.zh: 贝尔先生仍然每周在河边教我。

sentences.en: Or sometimes we just sit there and watch the boats.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们只是坐在那里看小船。

sentences.en: Science says music helps the heart, and I believe that is true.
sentences.zh: 科学说音乐对心脏有好处，我相信这是真的。

sentences.en: I love my mother, my teacher, and my little town.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的妈妈、我的老师，还有我的小镇。

sentences.en: Every good tale needs a hard part, and ours had one, but it ended with a song.
sentences.zh: 每个好故事都有一段艰难的经历，我们的故事也有，但它以一首歌收尾。

sentences.en: Last autumn, my cousin Tom and I planned a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，我和表哥汤姆计划了一个大惊喜。

sentences.en: It was for our dear Aunt Mary.
sentences.zh: 这是为我们亲爱的玛丽姑妈准备的。

sentences.en: Her birthday was coming that weekend.
sentences.zh: 那个周末就是她的生日。

sentences.en: She is a kind woman who lives alone on a small farm.
sentences.zh: 她是一位善良的女士，独自住在一个小农场里。

sentences.en: Every year she bakes sweet things for us, but nobody bakes anything for her.
sentences.zh: 每年她都为我们烤好吃的甜点，却没有人为她做过什么。

sentences.en: This time, we wanted to change everything.
sentences.zh: 这一次，我们想改变这一切。

sentences.en: Tom said, 'Let's make a cake and visit her farm.'
sentences.zh: 汤姆说：“我们做个蛋糕，去她的农场看她吧。”

sentences.en: I told him it was a clever plan.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他这是个聪明的计划。

sentences.en: So we began to work on it that evening.
sentences.zh: 于是那天晚上我们就开始行动了。

sentences.en: We only had one week to get everything ready.
sentences.zh: 我们只有一周的时间把一切准备好。

sentences.en: The next morning, we sat at my desk to write a list.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我们坐在我的书桌前写清单。

sentences.en: I turned on the computer to look for an easy recipe.
sentences.zh: 我打开电脑，寻找一个简单的食谱。

sentences.en: Tom read every word on the screen slowly and carefully.
sentences.zh: 汤姆慢慢地、仔细地读着屏幕上的每一个词。

sentences.en: 'Wait, is this number right or wrong?' I asked.
sentences.zh: “等等，这个数字是对的还是错的？”我问。

sentences.en: He checked it again and said it was fine.
sentences.zh: 他又检查了一遍，说没问题。

sentences.en: We wrote down apples and bananas for the top of the cake.
sentences.zh: 我们写下了苹果和香蕉，用来装饰蛋糕顶部。

sentences.en: We also added some little candy stars to the list.
sentences.zh: 我们还在清单上加了一些小小的星星糖果。

sentences.en: 'Don't say a thing to Mom yet,' Tom whispered.
sentences.zh: “先别跟妈妈说。”汤姆小声说。

sentences.en: But my dad walked in at that exact moment.
sentences.zh: 但就在那一刻，我爸爸走了进来。

sentences.en: He smiled at us and promised to keep our secret.
sentences.zh: 他朝我们笑了笑，答应替我们保密。

sentences.en: That afternoon, we took the bus to the market.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，我们坐公共汽车去市场。

sentences.en: The streets were busy with people buying fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 街上很热闹，人们都在买水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: I carried a big white bag for our shopping.
sentences.zh: 我拎着一个大大的白色袋子装东西。

sentences.en: We chose red apples, yellow bananas, and six fresh eggs.
sentences.zh: 我们挑了红苹果、黄香蕉，还有六个新鲜鸡蛋。

sentences.en: A young man at one shop sold us the star candy.
sentences.zh: 一家店里的年轻人卖给我们星星糖果。

sentences.en: 'Thank you very much,' we said to him politely.
sentences.zh: “非常感谢！”我们礼貌地对他说。

sentences.en: On the way home, Tom saw a basketball in a shop window.
sentences.zh: 回家路上，汤姆看见商店橱窗里有一个篮球。

sentences.en: He wanted to stop and watch, but there was no time left.
sentences.zh: 他想停下来看看，但是已经没有时间了。

sentences.en: 'Come on, we still have a lot to do,' I said.
sentences.zh: “快走吧，我们还有很多事要做呢。”我说。

sentences.en: We hurried back home before the clock struck five.
sentences.zh: 我们赶在钟敲五点之前回到了家。

sentences.en: The baking did not begin well at all.
sentences.zh: 烘焙一开始就很不顺利。

sentences.en: First, Tom poured in far too much water.
sentences.zh: 一开始，汤姆倒了太多的水。

sentences.en: Then the mix looked just like thin soup.
sentences.zh: 然后面糊看起来简直像稀汤一样。

sentences.en: I tried to fix it with more flour.
sentences.zh: 我试着多加些面粉来补救。

sentences.en: Suddenly, our cat jumped up onto the table.
sentences.zh: 突然，我们家的猫跳上了桌子。

sentences.en: She knocked over a chair and ran out of the room.
sentences.zh: 她撞倒了一把椅子，跑出了房间。

sentences.en: Flour flew everywhere, even under the big desk.
sentences.zh: 面粉飞得到处都是，连大书桌底下都是。

sentences.en: Tom was angry at first, but then he started to laugh.
sentences.zh: 汤姆起初很生气，但随后笑了起来。

sentences.en: We cleaned the whole kitchen together, singing a silly song.
sentences.zh: 我们一边唱着傻傻的歌，一边把整个厨房打扫干净。

sentences.en: The second cake came out of the oven golden and perfect.
sentences.zh: 第二个蛋糕出炉时金黄漂亮，非常完美。

sentences.en: On Saturday morning, we got out of bed very early.
sentences.zh: 星期六早上，我们很早就起床了。

sentences.en: For breakfast, we ate warm bread with honey.
sentences.zh: 早餐我们吃了抹蜂蜜的热面包。

sentences.en: I put on my thick coat because the wind was cold.
sentences.zh: 因为风很冷，我穿上了厚外套。

sentences.en: Tom wore his favorite blue cap.
sentences.zh: 汤姆戴上了他最喜欢的蓝色帽子。

sentences.en: 'What else should we bring for her?' he asked.
sentences.zh: “我们还应该给她带点什么？”他问。

sentences.en: 'These flowers and those two cards,' I answered.
sentences.zh: “这些花，还有那两张卡片。”我回答。

sentences.en: Dad had to work, so he could not drive us there.
sentences.zh: 爸爸要上班，所以不能开车送我们去。

sentences.en: 'Why not ride your bikes to the farm?' he suggested.
sentences.zh: “为什么不骑你们的自行车去农场呢？”他建议道。

sentences.en: 'Good idea! It is not far,' Tom said happily.
sentences.zh: “好主意！不远。”汤姆开心地说。

sentences.en: We tied the cake box on carefully and said bye to Dad.
sentences.zh: 我们小心地绑好蛋糕盒，跟爸爸说了再见。

sentences.en: The morning air smelled like fallen leaves and rain.
sentences.zh: 清晨的空气里有落叶和雨水的味道。

sentences.en: We rode along a quiet street by the river.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着河边一条安静的街道骑行。

sentences.en: A small boat floated slowly on the calm river.
sentences.zh: 一只小船在平静的河面上缓缓漂着。

sentences.en: Birds sang in the tall trees above our heads.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿在我们头顶高高的树上唱歌。

sentences.en: 'Look at the colors of the leaves!' I shouted to Tom.
sentences.zh: “看这些树叶的颜色！”我朝汤姆喊道。

sentences.en: Red and gold - autumn is my favorite colour of all.
sentences.zh: 红色和金色——秋天是我最喜欢的颜色。

sentences.en: But halfway there, my front tire went flat.
sentences.zh: 但是走到一半，我的前胎瘪了。

sentences.en: 'Oh no, what do we do now?' Tom asked.
sentences.zh: “哦不，我们现在怎么办？”汤姆问。

sentences.en: 'We push the bikes and go on foot,' I said.
sentences.zh: “我们推着车走过去。”我说。

sentences.en: It was a long walk, but we did not give up.
sentences.zh: 走了很长的路，但我们没有放弃。

sentences.en: When we finally arrived, Aunt Mary was feeding her animals.
sentences.zh: 当我们终于到达时，玛丽姑妈正在喂她的动物们。

sentences.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the wooden gate.
sentences.zh: 一头棕色的奶牛安静地站在木门旁边。

sentences.en: A fat chicken ran right between our legs.
sentences.zh: 一只肥母鸡从我们腿间跑了过去。

sentences.en: 'My dears! What are you doing here today?' she called in surprise.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的孩子们！你们今天怎么来了？”她惊讶地喊道。

sentences.en: 'Happy birthday!' we shouted together and held up the cake box.
sentences.zh: “生日快乐！”我们一起喊道，举起了蛋糕盒。

sentences.en: She opened her arms wide and hugged us both.
sentences.zh: 她张开双臂，把我们俩紧紧抱住。

sentences.en: Then happy tears came, and she began to cry softly.
sentences.zh: 接着幸福的眼泪涌了出来，她轻轻地哭了。

sentences.en: 'You remembered my special day,' she said quietly.
sentences.zh: “你们记得我的特别日子。”她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Of course we did,' Tom answered with a big smile.
sentences.zh: “我们当然记得。”汤姆笑着回答。

sentences.en: 'Your cake is a little shaky from the road, but it is full of love.'
sentences.zh: “你的蛋糕在路上有点晃歪了，但它满满的都是爱。”

sentences.en: We carried the cake into the warm kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我们把蛋糕搬进温暖的厨房。

sentences.en: Aunt Mary used her best plates for our little party.
sentences.zh: 玛丽姑妈拿出她最好的盘子来办我们的小派对。

sentences.en: Two women from the next farm came over to join us.
sentences.zh: 隔壁农场的两位女士也过来加入我们。

sentences.en: They brought a soft toy bear as their gift.
sentences.zh: 她们带来一只柔软的玩具熊作为礼物。

sentences.en: 'Whose idea was this lovely party?' one of them asked.
sentences.zh: “这个可爱的派对是谁的主意？”她们中的一位问道。

sentences.en: 'It was our idea together,' I said proudly.
sentences.zh: “是我们俩一起想的。”我骄傲地说。

sentences.en: For lunch, Aunt Mary cooked her famous chicken soup.
sentences.zh: 午餐时，玛丽姑妈做了她拿手的鸡汤。

sentences.en: After eating, she put on some old music.
sentences.zh: 吃完饭，她放起了一些老音乐。

sentences.en: We all began to dance around the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 我们都围着厨房的桌子跳起舞来。

sentences.en: I was afraid the cake would fall off, but it stood strong.
sentences.zh: 我担心蛋糕会掉下来，但它稳稳地立着。

sentences.en: In the golden afternoon light, she showed us the whole farm.
sentences.zh: 在金色的午后阳光里，她带我们参观了整个农场。

sentences.en: 'Where do all the chickens sleep at night?' Tom asked her.
sentences.zh: “鸡晚上都睡在哪里？”汤姆问她。

sentences.en: She showed us a little wooden house behind the barn.
sentences.zh: 她指给我们看谷仓后面的一间小木屋。

sentences.en: They all laughed and talked until the sun went down.
sentences.zh: 大家又说又笑，一直到太阳落山。

sentences.en: 'I think this is my best day in many years,' Aunt Mary said.
sentences.zh: “我觉得这是我很多年来最开心的一天。”玛丽姑妈说。

sentences.en: 'Do you want to stay for dinner too?' she asked us.
sentences.zh: “你们想不想留下来吃晚饭？”她问我们。

sentences.en: We called Dad on the phone, and he said yes.
sentences.zh: 我们给爸爸打了电话，他答应了。

sentences.en: After dinner, she gave us warm clothes for the cold night.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，她给我们拿了保暖的衣服，好抵御寒夜。

sentences.en: Dad drove over later to take us and the broken bike home.
sentences.zh: 后来爸爸开车过来，把我们和坏了的自行车接回家。

sentences.en: 'Come back tomorrow if you can,' Aunt Mary said at the gate.
sentences.zh: “如果可以，明天再来吧。”玛丽姑妈在门口说。

sentences.en: 'We can go to the cinema in town and see a film.'
sentences.zh: “我们可以去镇上的电影院看场电影。”

sentences.en: 'We would love that,' we answered together.
sentences.zh: “我们非常乐意。”我们齐声回答。

sentences.en: We waved until the little farm disappeared behind the hill.
sentences.zh: 我们一直挥手，直到小农场消失在山丘后面。

sentences.en: On the drive home, Tom fell asleep next to me.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，汤姆在我旁边睡着了。

sentences.en: I watched the first star appear in the dark sky.
sentences.zh: 我看着第一颗星星出现在夜空中。

sentences.en: The best gifts are not expensive things, I understood then.
sentences.zh: 那时我明白了，最好的礼物并不是昂贵的东西。

sentences.en: The best gifts are love, time, and the people around us.
sentences.zh: 最好的礼物是爱、时间，还有我们身边的人。

sentences.en: Next year, we will bake an even bigger cake for her.
sentences.zh: 明年，我们要为她烤一个更大的蛋糕。

sentences.en: And this time, we will keep the cat far away from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 而且这一次，我们一定让猫远离厨房。

sentences.en: Lily was a ten-year-old kid who lived in a big city.
sentences.zh: 莉莉是一个住在大城市里的十岁孩子。

sentences.en: Every day she went to school with her little sister.
sentences.zh: 她每天和妹妹一起去上学。

sentences.en: She liked art class, but she was not good at math.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢美术课，但数学不太好。

sentences.en: It was her hardest subject.
sentences.zh: 那是她最难的科目。

sentences.en: Her teacher was a kind woman named Ms. Green.
sentences.zh: 她的老师是一位和蔼的女士，名叫格林女士。

sentences.en: In every lesson, Lily wrote carefully with her old pen.
sentences.zh: 每节课上，莉莉都用她的旧钢笔认真书写。

sentences.en: By the end of the school year, she felt very tired.
sentences.zh: 到学年结束时，她感到非常疲惫。

sentences.en: Her eyes hurt from looking at the computer too much.
sentences.zh: 因为看电脑太多，她的眼睛很疼。

sentences.en: "You need a holiday in the countryside," her mum said one morning.
sentences.zh: “你需要去乡下度个假，”一天早上妈妈说。

sentences.en: It was spring, and the school break had just started.
sentences.zh: 当时是春天，学校假期刚刚开始。

sentences.en: Her parents decided to send her to her grandparents' farm.
sentences.zh: 父母决定送她去祖父母的农场。

sentences.en: They did not go by plane because it was not far.
sentences.zh: 因为路不远，他们没有坐飞机。

sentences.en: First, they took a taxi to the station.
sentences.zh: 他们先坐出租车去车站。

sentences.en: The driver smiled and helped them with their bags.
sentences.zh: 司机微笑着帮他们拿行李。

sentences.en: Then they rode a slow train through green hills.
sentences.zh: 然后他们坐上一列慢悠悠的火车，穿过青翠的山丘。

sentences.en: Lily looked at a map and counted the small towns.
sentences.zh: 莉莉看着地图，数着沿途的小镇。

sentences.en: The trip took two hours, but she was happy the whole way.
sentences.zh: 旅途花了两个小时，但她一路都很开心。

sentences.en: "Hello, my dear!" Grandma shouted at the gate.
sentences.zh: “你好，亲爱的！”奶奶在门口喊道。

sentences.en: Her grandmother wore a long blue dress and a big smile.
sentences.zh: 她的祖母穿着一条蓝色长裙，脸上带着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: Grandfather stood behind her with open arms.
sentences.zh: 爷爷张开双臂站在她身后。

sentences.en: He was tall, with kind eyes and a white beard.
sentences.zh: 他个子很高，有一双慈祥的眼睛和白色的胡子。

sentences.en: The day was sunny, and the air felt fresh and warm.
sentences.zh: 那天阳光明媚，空气清新而温暖。

sentences.en: Lily hugged them and forgot the noisy city at once.
sentences.zh: 莉莉拥抱了他们，一下子就忘掉了喧闹的城市。

sentences.en: The next morning, Grandfather showed her around the farm.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，爷爷带她参观了农场。

sentences.en: A fat pig slept in the mud near the gate.
sentences.zh: 一头肥猪睡在大门旁的泥地里。

sentences.en: White sheep ate green grass on the hill.
sentences.zh: 白色的绵羊在山坡上吃着青草。

sentences.en: A brown horse ran fast around the field.
sentences.zh: 一匹棕色的马在田野里飞快地奔跑。

sentences.en: A mother duck walked with her babies to the water.
sentences.zh: 一只鸭妈妈带着孩子们走向水边。

sentences.en: In the hen house, Lily found three brown eggs.
sentences.zh: 在鸡舍里，莉莉找到了三个棕色的鸡蛋。

sentences.en: "A farmer's day starts early," Grandfather said with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “农民的一天开始得早，”爷爷笑着说。

sentences.en: Lily also saw a cow and a clever cat by the door.
sentences.zh: 莉莉还看到了一头奶牛和门边一只聪明的猫。

sentences.en: The animals were noisy, but Lily loved every sound.
sentences.zh: 动物们很吵闹，但莉莉喜欢每一种声音。

sentences.en: Grandma's kitchen always smelled wonderful.
sentences.zh: 奶奶的厨房总是香气扑鼻。

sentences.en: For breakfast, she drank fresh milk from the cow.
sentences.zh: 早餐时，她喝了刚挤的新鲜牛奶。

sentences.en: Grandma also made her a glass of orange juice.
sentences.zh: 奶奶还给她做了一杯橙汁。

sentences.en: There was always fresh fruit on the table too.
sentences.zh: 桌上也总是摆着新鲜的水果。

sentences.en: For lunch, they ate rice with fresh vegetables.
sentences.zh: 午餐他们吃米饭配新鲜蔬菜。

sentences.en: Lily's favourite dish was the hot soup.
sentences.zh: 莉莉最喜欢的菜是那道热汤。

sentences.en: It was made with potatoes from the garden.
sentences.zh: 汤是用园子里的土豆做的。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, everyone had black tea on the porch.
sentences.zh: 下午，大家在门廊上喝红茶。

sentences.en: Farm work made Lily hungry all the time.
sentences.zh: 农场的活儿让莉莉总是觉得饿。

sentences.en: At dinner, everyone sat together and talked about their day.
sentences.zh: 晚餐时，大家坐在一起聊各自的一天。

sentences.en: Behind the farm, there was a small blue lake.
sentences.zh: 农场后面有一个蓝色的小湖。

sentences.en: On hot days, Lily put on her shorts and an old shirt.
sentences.zh: 天热的时候，莉莉会穿上短裤和一件旧衬衫。

sentences.en: She took off her shoes and ran on the soft grass.
sentences.zh: 她脱掉鞋子，在柔软的草地上奔跑。

sentences.en: The cool water felt good on her feet.
sentences.zh: 凉凉的水拂过双脚，感觉很舒服。

sentences.en: She learned to swim a little in the shallow part.
sentences.zh: 她在浅水区学会了一点游泳。

sentences.en: Once she cut her foot on a stone, but it was fine.
sentences.zh: 有一次她的脚被石头划破了，但没什么大碍。

sentences.en: Grandfather taught her to catch fish in the early morning.
sentences.zh: 爷爷教她在清晨钓鱼。

sentences.en: She loved to jump over the small stream near the water.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢跳过水边的小溪。

sentences.en: "This is better than any sport in the city," she thought.
sentences.zh: “这比城里任何运动都好，”她想。

sentences.en: All this exercise made her strong and brown from the sun.
sentences.zh: 这些锻炼让她变得强壮，皮肤也被太阳晒成了棕色。

sentences.en: One evening, everything changed.
sentences.zh: 一天傍晚，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Grandfather was carrying a heavy bag when he fell down.
sentences.zh: 爷爷提着一个很重的袋子时摔倒了。

sentences.en: He hurt his leg and could not stand up.
sentences.zh: 他伤了腿，站不起来。

sentences.en: "I feel ill," he said in a quiet voice.
sentences.zh: “我觉得不舒服，”他小声说。

sentences.en: Grandma called the doctor from the village right away.
sentences.zh: 奶奶立刻打电话请村里的医生来。

sentences.en: The doctor came with a young nurse in a white coat.
sentences.zh: 医生带着一位穿白大褂的年轻护士来了。

sentences.en: "He must rest for one week, Mrs. Brown," the doctor said.
sentences.zh: “布朗太太，他必须休息一个星期，”医生说。

sentences.en: Lily felt sad and could not sleep that night.
sentences.zh: 莉莉很难过，那天晚上睡不着。

sentences.en: The next day, Lily decided to help with everything.
sentences.zh: 第二天，莉莉决定帮忙做所有的事。

sentences.en: She fed the animals and cleaned the dirty floor.
sentences.zh: 她喂了动物，还打扫了脏地板。

sentences.en: She even washed the toilet without being asked.
sentences.zh: 她甚至主动把厕所也洗干净了。

sentences.en: In the garden, she gave water to every plant.
sentences.zh: 在园子里，她给每一株植物浇了水。

sentences.en: She picked a pretty flower and put it by Grandfather's bed.
sentences.zh: 她摘了一朵漂亮的花，放在爷爷的床边。

sentences.en: Under the big apple tree, she read stories to him.
sentences.zh: 在大苹果树下，她给爷爷读故事。

sentences.en: Grandma said, "You are such a good girl, dear."
sentences.zh: 奶奶说：“亲爱的，你真是个好孩子。”

sentences.en: Working hard felt good, and she was proud of herself.
sentences.zh: 努力干活的感觉真好，她为自己感到骄傲。

sentences.en: To make Grandfather laugh, Lily started to draw funny animals.
sentences.zh: 为了逗爷爷笑，莉莉开始画滑稽的动物。

sentences.en: First came an elephant with a very long nose.
sentences.zh: 第一张是一头鼻子特别长的大象。

sentences.en: Then came a tiger with big teeth and a funny monkey.
sentences.zh: 接着是一只长着大牙齿的老虎和一只滑稽的猴子。

sentences.en: Grandfather laughed so hard that tears came to his eyes.
sentences.zh: 爷爷笑得眼泪都出来了。

sentences.en: At night, they went outside and watched the moon.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他们到外面看月亮。

sentences.en: Birds would fly home over the fields as the sky turned pink.
sentences.zh: 天空变成粉色时，鸟儿飞过田野回家。

sentences.en: Grandma liked to sing old songs in a soft voice.
sentences.zh: 奶奶喜欢用轻柔的声音唱老歌。

sentences.en: Lily took a photo of them with her camera.
sentences.zh: 莉莉用相机给他们拍了一张照片。

sentences.en: She also found a box of old toys in her mother's room.
sentences.zh: 她还在妈妈的房间里找到一箱旧玩具。

sentences.en: A few days later, the weather changed and rain fell all day.
sentences.zh: 几天后，天气变了，雨下了一整天。

sentences.en: "In winter, this whole farm is white with snow," Grandma said.
sentences.zh: “到了冬天，整个农场都会被雪覆盖成白色，”奶奶说。

sentences.en: Lily walked to the village shop to buy some bread.
sentences.zh: 莉莉走到村里的商店去买面包。

sentences.en: The owner was a thin man with a friendly smile.
sentences.zh: 店主是个瘦瘦的男人，笑容很友好。

sentences.en: He also sold her a small paper fan for hot days.
sentences.zh: 他还卖给她一把天热时用的小纸扇。

sentences.en: Back home, she helped in the house and read books.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，她帮忙做家务，还看了书。

sentences.en: After a week, Grandfather's leg was much better.
sentences.zh: 一个星期后，爷爷的腿好多了。

sentences.en: The doctor came back and checked his ears and mouth.
sentences.zh: 医生回来检查了他的耳朵和嘴巴。

sentences.en: "You are healthy again," she said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “你又恢复健康了，”她微笑着说。

sentences.en: "Walk for ten minutes every day," she told him.
sentences.zh: “每天散步十分钟，”她叮嘱他。

sentences.en: Grandfather thanked Lily for all her help during those days.
sentences.zh: 爷爷感谢莉莉这些天来的帮助。

sentences.en: Everyone in the house was happy again.
sentences.zh: 屋子里的每个人又都开心起来了。

sentences.en: Soon, the holiday came to an end.
sentences.zh: 很快，假期就结束了。

sentences.en: Her favorite memory was the morning by the water.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢的回忆是在水边度过的清晨。

sentences.en: Her uncle drove from the city to pick her up.
sentences.zh: 她的叔叔从城里开车来接她。

sentences.en: "Come back soon," said Grandma, and Grandfather nodded.
sentences.zh: “早点回来，”奶奶说，爷爷也点了点头。

sentences.en: "Goodbye! I will send you an email every week!" Lily shouted.
sentences.zh: “再见！我每周都会给你们发电子邮件！”莉莉喊道。

sentences.en: From the car window, the farm looked like a little ship on a green sea.
sentences.zh: 从车窗望去，农场就像绿色海洋上的一艘小船。

sentences.en: She knew she would come back next spring.
sentences.zh: 她知道明年春天她还会回来。

sentences.en: Yesterday morning, snow fell quietly outside the classroom window.
sentences.zh: 昨天早上，雪花静静地飘落在教室窗外。

sentences.en: It was the coldest week of winter.
sentences.zh: 这是冬天里最冷的一周。

sentences.en: Mia, a young pupil in Class Three, sat at her desk and sighed.
sentences.zh: 米娅是三班的一名小学生，她坐在课桌前叹了口气。

sentences.en: The teacher was writing numbers on the blackboard.
sentences.zh: 老师正在黑板上写数字。

sentences.en: Mia held her pencil, but her mind was far away.
sentences.zh: 米娅握着铅笔，心思却早已飘远了。

sentences.en: She had a big maths test on Friday, and she felt afraid.
sentences.zh: 周五她有一场重要的数学考试，她感到很害怕。

sentences.en: Her ruler slipped off the desk, and she didn't even notice.
sentences.zh: 她的尺子从桌上滑落，她甚至都没有察觉。

sentences.en: After class, the other children ran to the playground.
sentences.zh: 下课后，其他孩子都跑去了操场。

sentences.en: Mia stayed inside and drew sad pictures with a blue crayon.
sentences.zh: 米娅留在教室里，用蓝色蜡笔画着忧伤的画。

sentences.en: At home, she dropped her schoolbag by the door and said nothing.
sentences.zh: 回到家，她把书包丢在门边，一句话也不说。

sentences.en: Her grandpa saw her face and understood at once.
sentences.zh: 爷爷一看到她的表情，立刻就明白了。

sentences.en: "Don't worry about the test," he said softly.
sentences.zh: “别为考试担心。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: "Study with me every evening, and on Saturday I will take you to the zoo."
sentences.zh: “每天晚上跟我一起学习，周六我就带你去动物园。”

sentences.en: Mia smiled for the first time that day.
sentences.zh: 那天，米娅第一次露出了笑容。

sentences.en: Each night that week, they practiced numbers together at the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 那一周，他们每天晚上都在厨房的桌子旁一起练习算数。

sentences.en: Grandpa made hot noodle soup when Mia felt tired.
sentences.zh: 米娅累的时候，爷爷就给她做热腾腾的汤面。

sentences.en: Slowly, the questions became easy, like a game.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，那些题目变得简单起来，就像做游戏一样。

sentences.en: On Friday, Mia wrote every answer carefully and finished with a happy heart.
sentences.zh: 周五，米娅认真地写下每一个答案，带着愉快的心情完成了考试。

sentences.en: On Saturday, the weather was cloudy but not too cold.
sentences.zh: 周六，天气多云，但不算太冷。

sentences.en: Mia put on her red sweater and warm trousers.
sentences.zh: 米娅穿上了红毛衣和暖和的长裤。

sentences.en: She found one yellow sock, then its twin, and laughed at herself.
sentences.zh: 她先找到一只黄袜子，又找到另一只，忍不住笑了自己一番。

sentences.en: Grandpa said she could not wear her thin skirt in such cold air.
sentences.zh: 爷爷说，这么冷的天可不能穿那条薄裙子。

sentences.en: They took an umbrella, just in case.
sentences.zh: 他们带上了一把伞，以防万一。

sentences.en: Then they rode a bicycle together to the city zoo.
sentences.zh: 然后他们一起骑自行车前往城里的动物园。

sentences.en: A friendly worker stood at the gate and said, "Welcome!"
sentences.zh: 一位友善的工作人员站在大门口说：“欢迎！”

sentences.en: First they visited the panda, who ate bamboo like a lazy king.
sentences.zh: 他们先去看了大熊猫，它像个懒洋洋的国王一样吃着竹子。

sentences.en: Outside the tiger house, the day suddenly turned windy.
sentences.zh: 在老虎馆外面，天忽然刮起了大风。

sentences.en: Mia's paper kite flew out of her hands and into a tall tree.
sentences.zh: 米娅的纸风筝从她手中飞了出去，挂在了一棵高高的树上。

sentences.en: She almost cried, but a kind man climbed up and brought it back.
sentences.zh: 她差点哭了出来，好在一位好心人爬上去把风筝取了回来。

sentences.en: "What a wonderful day," Mia said, holding her kite tightly.
sentences.zh: “真是美好的一天！”米娅紧紧抱着风筝说。

sentences.en: On the way home, they stopped at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，他们在超市停了下来。

sentences.en: He bought a fat red tomato and every green vegetable Mia liked.
sentences.zh: 爷爷买了一个又大又红的番茄，还有米娅爱吃的各种绿色蔬菜。

sentences.en: At home, Mia helped wash everything in the kitchen sink.
sentences.zh: 回到家，米娅帮忙在厨房水池里把所有东西洗干净。

sentences.en: The next Monday, the teacher smiled and gave back the tests.
sentences.zh: 下周一，老师微笑着把试卷发了回来。

sentences.en: Mia had the best mark in her class.
sentences.zh: 米娅得了全班最好的成绩。

sentences.en: That evening she hugged her grandpa and said, "You are my best teacher."
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她抱住爷爷说：“你是我最好的老师。”
